project.name: Kilmaron Castle
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: The historic records remain intact, but no unrestricted public attraction or facility is claimed. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. The private walled garden and estate buildings are not See cards. No score is awarded merely for designation records.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Kilmaron Castle is a historic record rather than a visitor destination: the 1815 mansion is demolished and surviving estate structures are private.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No dedicated dog destination or blanket off-lead suitability is assumed.
